description: Department Census and Statistics - National Consumer Price Index - August - 2024
categorisation: This gazette content announces the National Consumer Price Index for August 2024, computed by the Department of Census and Statistics. It is a statistical notification that does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and does not fit into any of the specialized categories (Types 4-9) such as land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters. It is an administrative statistical announcement, making it Miscellaneous (Type 10).
